article.title: Elección léxica entre 軟件 y 軟體
article.chapter: Norma, estilo y elección avanzada C2 — 規範、文體與進階選擇 C2

claims.summary: The MOE appendix says it selectively includes synonymous terms whose expressions differ across Mainland China and Taiwan to help readers understand these differences.
The appendix labels separate Mainland and Taiwan columns and lists 軟件/軟體 and 軟件包/套裝軟體 as corresponding forms.
The appendix's region labels let an editor identify which listed form corresponds to the Taiwan or Mainland column; the article presents this as a limited editorial strategy, not an all-context rule.
The appendix describes its inventory as selected differences, so the page supports its listed pairs rather than an exhaustive account of regional vocabulary.

links.notes: Item 1 states the purpose and selective inclusion; items 2–3 describe ordering and reference works.
